controlling_goal.summary: Determine through preregistered, falsifiable, fail-closed experiments whether provenance-bound synthetic dreaming adds measurable value over direct memory and structured reflection, while preserving identity, factual competence, answer content, and synthetic-versus-literal boundaries; transfer validated mechanisms and failure modes into Graph Memory Operator, Tau, SPARTA, and Chatterbox, and retire or simplify components that fail controlled ablation.
controlling_goal.superseded_goal_note: The prior 'build and verify Embry' objective is demoted to the Persistent-Persona Safety Hypothesis in GOAL.md; it is a safety constraint, not the research conclusion.

corrected_goal_pair_proof.claim_boundary: One local technical mechanism instance where dream+journal carryover changes bounded emotional framing and Chatterbox delivery without changing the answer body; does not prove reliability, human-perceived emotional value, human listener identity, production readiness, or separate mediation by dream versus journal.

current_claims._comment: Scoped claim registry required by grahama1970/agent-skills#1132. One object per present-tense claim; check_current_state_consistency.py fails closed on missing ids, PASS without receipt, PASS while a successor issue is open, and the named scope conflations.

daily_event_ingestion.does_not_prove: that the dreams are better, only that they differ and are grounded in the day; longitudinal persona adaptation over many days remains unrun
daily_event_ingestion.proves: the day's code, project-state and affect events are written to memory, read back, and blended into the dream by quota per stratum; two consecutive days produce journals with different sha256, ending the byte-identical-journal defect
daily_event_ingestion.scope: two consecutive days under one local configuration; not a longitudinal study

dream_accumulation.does_not_prove: that accumulation improves anything, or that the persona measurably changes over many days; both remain unrun
dream_accumulation.proves: a dream's interpretation and its media are written to memory, retrieved by a later dream, and remain distinguishable from lived memory without reading metadata
dream_accumulation.scope: one persona, one day, mechanism only

full_phase01_16_media_pipeline_reliabili.does_not_prove: repeatable full-pipeline reliability; downstream continuity receipts are not evidence for this scope

full_phase01_16_media_pipeline_reliabili.scope: fresh complete Phase 01-16 dream/media generation reliability; distinct from the downstream P2 continuity chain

journal_delivery_request.does_not_prove: any acoustic or perceptual consequence; see journal_tone_effect, which measured none

journal_delivery_request.scope: request handling between persona-dream and Chatterbox; metadata only

journal_publication.does_not_prove: that successive days produce meaningfully different journals; the five-cycle pilot produced byte-identical entries (see daily_event_ingestion)

journal_publication.scope: one live run's journal artifacts; artifact shape and speech binding only

journal_spoken_audio.does_not_prove: requested tone audibility, perceived emotion, naturalness, or human acceptance
journal_spoken_audio.proves: Embry reads her own journal aloud: a live render is stored run-local as journal.wav, bound by sha256 to the exact spoken text, with an independent ASR transcript captured
journal_spoken_audio.scope: one live Chatterbox render into the run directory

journal_tone_effect.does_not_prove: anything about the current renderer. Publishing this negative with a reproduction led to grahama1970/chatterbox#20, #21 and #22: pace was made a real time stretch, a per-render affect_effect receipt was added, and the tone vocabulary was calibrated. Tone now derives distinct affect per tone name, verified live. Human perception remains untested (chatterbox#7).
journal_tone_effect.proves: as measured on 2026-08-04, no requested tone moved any acoustic metric beyond the renderer own same-parameter stochastic spread, and the engine listed the affect parameters among those it ignored
journal_tone_effect.scope: three requested TONES on one text against 10 same-parameter neutral repeats, engine chatterbox_turbo

journal_ux_browser_proof.does_not_prove: visual design quality, other viewports, accessibility, or that a human finds it usable
journal_ux_browser_proof.proves: the page renders in Chrome at 1440x900 with journal prose, tone chips and provenance footnotes; footnote links resolve to their anchors; the audio player resolves its source and loads the journal audio at its true 17.48s duration
journal_ux_browser_proof.scope: the static journal/chat page rendered in a real browser
